description: MEKSOL crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: 2(C1 H6 N1 1+),2(C2 Cl3 O2 1-),C12 H12 Cl18 Gd2 O18,2(C2 H1 Cl3 O2). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd1A (Gd) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.202-4.202 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 104.38-104.38°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula (CH3NH3)2[Gd2(CCl3COO)6(H2O)6](CCl3COO)2·2CCl3COOH. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 6 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
